fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lamb''' fires a shot at the target enemy that {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 30% {{as|(+ 5% per 100 AP)}} for 1 second and marks them for 4 seconds. Her {{tip|basic attacks}} against the marked target each apply a {{tip|stack}}, refreshing the duration and stacking up to 3 times.
fields.description2: The third stack directs '''Wolf''' to pounce on the target, consuming all stacks to deal {{as|'''additional''' physical damage|physical damage}}, increased by {{critical damage|0 to 50|critScaling=true}}.
fields.leveling2: {{st|Additional Physical Damage|{{ap|80 to 200}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 5% {{as|(+ {{fd|0.5}}% per {{ai|Mark of the Kindred|Kindred|Mark}})|buzzword}} of target's '''missing''' health)}}}}
fields.description3: The damage based on the {{as|'''missing''' health}} ratio is capped at 200 against {{tip|monster|monsters}}.

dataPolicy.blockedDataPolicy: DDragon is provenance at most, NEVER current numeric truth. A mechanism may remain blocked_data only when the checked League Wiki template itself lacks or marks unknown the required numeric contract.
